name: ditbrowse
description: Fork of DIT Browse with SKAARHOJ Blue Pill camera-select routing triggers

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && rm -rf dist-electron && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.stage:companion-module: npm --prefix companion-module-lightlab-ditbrowse run package && node scripts/stage-companion-module.mjs --source companion-module-lightlab-ditbrowse/pkg/lightlab-ditbrowse --base-package companion-module-lightlab-ditbrowse/node_modules/@companion-module/base/package.json --output resources/companion-module/lightlab-ditbrowse
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:mac-icon && npm run build && npm run stage:companion-module && electron-packager . DITBrowse --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=release --overwrite --prune=true --app-bundle-id=com.lightlab.ditbrowse --extra-resource=resources/companion-module --ignore="^/(?:\.worktrees|\.superpowers|src|tests|docs|test-results|release|release-candidate|companion-module-lightlab-ditbrowse|resources/companion-module)(?:/|$)|^/(?:playwright\.config\.ts|playwright\.electron\.config\.ts|vitest\.config\.ts|tsconfig\.json|tsconfig\.node\.json|vite\.config\.ts)$" && node scripts/apply-mac-icon.mjs
scripts.test:electron: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.electron.config.ts
